description: This file implements a RAPL MSR energy reader for Intel and AMD CPUs, including functions to open and read MSR registers, determine CPU vendor, and calculate energy consumption.

classes.name: resource_usage_utils::rapl_msr_reader
classes.description: A class for reading energy consumption data from MSR registers on Intel and AMD CPUs.

methods.name: resource_usage_utils::rapl_msr_reader::read_consumed_energy
methods.description: Reads the current energy consumption from MSR registers for package and CPU cores.

methods.name: resource_usage_utils::rapl_msr_reader::initialize_units
methods.description: Initializes energy units based on MSR register data.

methods.name: build_rapl_msr_reader
methods.description: Factory function to create a RAPL MSR energy reader instance.
